import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import type { RunConfig } from "./types";

/**
 * Where run outputs live. Eval suites and the user view are kept apart:
 *   data/evals/<arenaId>/{runs,traces}/   — eval suite runs (one folder per suite)
 *   data/user-view/{runs,traces}/         — user-view runs (pre-runs + fresh runs)
 */
export const DATA = () => path.resolve(process.cwd(), "data");
export const scopeDir = (cfg: Pick<RunConfig, "arena" | "group">) =>
  cfg.arena && cfg.arena !== "user-view" ? path.join(DATA(), "evals", cfg.arena) : path.join(DATA(), "user-view");

/** Every scope folder that exists (each has runs/ and traces/). */
export function scopeDirs(): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const evals = path.join(DATA(), "evals");
  if (fs.existsSync(evals)) for (const a of fs.readdirSync(evals)) out.push(path.join(evals, a));
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(DATA(), "user-view"))) out.push(path.join(DATA(), "user-view"));
  return out;
}

/** Find a run's file of the given kind by id, across all scopes. */
export function findFile(kind: "runs" | "traces", id: string): string | null {
  const name = kind === "runs" ? `${id}.json` : `${id}.jsonl`;
  for (const d of scopeDirs()) {
    const p = path.join(d, kind, name);
    if (fs.existsSync(p)) return p;
  }
  return null;
}
EOF

// Keep ONE canonical eval suite (+ user-view runs); delete everything else so the data isn't polluted.
// Also migrates the legacy flat layout (data/runs, data/traces) into data/evals/<arena>/ and data/user-view/.
// Deleted runs' spend is archived in data/spend-ledger.json first, so the budget cap still counts it.
//   npx tsx scripts/cleanup.mts --keep <arenaId> [--dry-run]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { DATA, scopeDir } from "../src/lib/paths";
import { archiveSpend, runCostUsd } from "../src/lib/store";
import type { RunRecord } from "../src/lib/types";

const { values: a } = parseArgs({ options: { keep: { type: "string" }, "dry-run": { type: "boolean", default: false } } });
if (!a.keep) throw new Error("--keep <arenaId> is required");
const dry = a["dry-run"];

// Every run file anywhere: legacy flat folder + scoped folders.
const runFiles: string[] = [];
const legacyRuns = path.join(DATA(), "runs");
if (fs.existsSync(legacyRuns)) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(legacyRuns)) if (f.endsWith(".json")) runFiles.push(path.join(legacyRuns, f));
for (const base of [path.join(DATA(), "evals"), DATA()])
  if (fs.existsSync(base))
    for (const d of fs.readdirSync(base)) {
      const r = path.join(base, d, "runs");
      if ((base !== DATA() || d === "user-view") && fs.existsSync(r)) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(r)) if (f.endsWith(".json")) runFiles.push(path.join(r, f));
    }

const legacyTrace = (id: string) => path.join(DATA(), "traces", `${id}.jsonl`);
let kept = 0, deleted = 0, usd = 0;
for (const f of runFiles) {
  const run = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")) as RunRecord;
  const isKeep = run.config.arena === a.keep;
  const isUserView = run.config.group === "user-view";
  if (isKeep && run.status === "running") throw new Error(`${a.keep} still has running runs`);
  if (isKeep || isUserView) {
    kept++;
    const dir = scopeDir(run.config);
    const dest = path.join(dir, "runs", `${run.id}.json`);
    if (f !== dest && !dry) {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
      fs.renameSync(f, dest);
      const t = legacyTrace(run.id);
      if (fs.existsSync(t)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, "traces"), { recursive: true });
        fs.renameSync(t, path.join(dir, "traces", `${run.id}.jsonl`));
      }
    }
  } else {
    deleted++;
    usd += runCostUsd(run);
    if (!dry) {
      fs.rmSync(f);
      fs.rmSync(legacyTrace(run.id), { force: true });
    }
  }
}
console.log(`keep ${kept} runs (${a.keep} + user view); delete ${deleted} runs ($${usd.toFixed(2)} → spend ledger)`);
if (dry) process.exit(0);
if (deleted) await archiveSpend({ reason: `cleanup: deleted ${deleted} runs not in canonical suite ${a.keep}`, runs: deleted, usd });

// Remove other eval-suite folders, leftovers of the flat layout, and regenerable caches.
const evals = path.join(DATA(), "evals");
if (fs.existsSync(evals)) for (const d of fs.readdirSync(evals)) if (d !== a.keep) fs.rmSync(path.join(evals, d), { recursive: true, force: true });
for (const d of ["runs", "traces", "cache", "labels"]) fs.rmSync(path.join(DATA(), d), { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log("done");
EOF

// Pre-compute user-view runs (winning setup on the demo companies) so the user view opens instantly.
//   npx tsx scripts/prerun.mts            # every demo company × every eval week
import { cellByKey, cellConfig } from "../src/lib/arena";
import { companies, experiment, manifest, pinConfig } from "../src/lib/config";
import { execute, newRun } from "../src/lib/pipeline/run";

pinConfig();
const cell = cellByKey(experiment().userView.setup)!;
const demos = companies().filter((c) => c.use === "demo");
const jobs = demos.flatMap((c) => manifest().weeks.map((w) => ({ c, w })));
await Promise.all(
  jobs.map(async ({ c, w }) => {
    const cfg = cellConfig(cell, { profileId: c.id, windowStart: w.windowStart, windowEnd: w.windowEnd, asOf: w.asOf }, "user-view");
    const r = await execute(newRun({ ...cfg, arena: undefined, group: "user-view" }));
    console.log(c.id, w.id, r.status, `${r.items?.length ?? 0} items`, `$${r.totalCostUsd.toFixed(3)}`, r.error ?? "");
  }),
);
EOF

import Link from "next/link";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import TryForm from "@/components/TryForm";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { companies, defaultEvalset, experiment, getCompany } from "@/lib/config";
import { listRuns } from "@/lib/store";

export default async function TryPage() {
  await connection();
  const demos = companies()
    .filter((c) => c.use === "demo")
    .map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, summary: c.summary }));
  const d = defaultEvalset();
  const ready = (await listRuns()).filter((r) => r.config.group === "user-view" && r.status === "done");
  const name = (id: string, custom?: { name: string }) => custom?.name ?? (() => { try { return getCompany(id).name; } catch { return id; } })();
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 items-center">
      {ready.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="w-full max-w-3xl">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Ready-made results</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Already run, so they open instantly. Each shows the action items and every step it took.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {ready.map((r) => (
              <Link key={r.id} href={`/try/${r.id}`} className="rounded-lg border p-3 hover:bg-muted">

import json,glob,collections

keys={}
for f in glob.glob('config/evalsets/keys/*.json'):
    k=json.load(open(f)); keys[(k['profileId'],k['windowStart'])]=k
un=collections.Counter(); miss=collections.Counter()
for f in glob.glob('data/evals/*/runs/*.json'):
    r=json.load(open(f)); c=r['config']
    if c['cell']!='jev-sonnet-strict': continue
    k=keys[(c['profileId'],c['windowStart'])]
    keyed=set(k['relevant'])|set(k.get('traps',{}))
    for i in r['items']:
        if i['document_number'] not in keyed: un[(c['evalset'],i['document_number'])]+=1
    for n in k['relevant']:
        if n not in {i['document_number'] for i in r['items']}: miss[(c['evalset'],n)]+=1
print('unlabeled:',dict(un)); print('missed:',dict(miss))
# were unlabeled ones dropped by reconcilers?
for (es,n),_ in un.items():
    co=es.split('_')[0]; w=es[len(co)+1:]
    try:
        k=json.load(open(D+f'key-{co}-{w}.json'))
        dec=[d for d in k.get('agreement',{}).get('decisions',[]) if d.get('doc')==n]
        print(n, 'reconciler decision:', dec[:1])
    except Exception as e: print(n, e)
EOF

"use client";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";

interface Props {
  evalsets: { id: string; label: string; split: string; docs: number; keyed: number | null }[];
  setups: { id: string; label: string; model: string; estUsd: number }[];
  repeatOptions: number[];
  spent: number;
  budget: number;
}

/** Start a new eval suite: pick eval sets × setups (both from config/), repeat N. */
export default function ArenaForm({ evalsets, setups, repeatOptions, spent, budget }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [sets, setSets] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(evalsets.map((e) => e.id)));
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(setups.map((s) => s.id)));
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState(repeatOptions.includes(3) ? 3 : repeatOptions[0]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const est = useMemo(() => setups.filter((s) => picked.has(s.id)).reduce((a, s) => a + s.estUsd, 0) * sets.size * repeat, [setups, picked, sets, repeat]);
  const left = budget - spent;
  const toggle = (set: Set<string>, fn: (s: Set<string>) => void, k: string) => {
    const n = new Set(set);
    if (n.has(k)) n.delete(k);
    else n.add(k);
    fn(n);
  };

  async function go() {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(null);
    const res = await fetch("/api/arena", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ evalsetIds: [...sets], cellKeys: [...picked], repeat }) });
    const j = await res.json();
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setErr(j.error);
    router.push(`/arena/${j.arena}`);
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Run a new eval suite</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Costs real money (est. below). Setups and eval sets come from <code>config/setups.yaml</code> and <code>config/evalsets/</code>.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Setups</span>
          {setups.map((s) => (
            <label key={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox checked={picked.has(s.id)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(picked, setPicked, s.id)} />
              {s.label} <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">≈${s.estUsd.toFixed(2)}/run</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Eval sets (company · week)</span>
          {evalsets.map((e) => (
            <label key={e.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox checked={sets.has(e.id)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(sets, setSets, e.id)} />
              {e.label} <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">({e.split})</span>
              <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.keyed ?? "no"} flags · {e.docs} docs</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="md:col-span-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
            Repeat each
            <select className="h-8 rounded-md border bg-background px-2" value={repeat} onChange={(e) => setRepeat(Number(e.target.value))}>
              {repeatOptions.map((n) => (
                <option key={n} value={n}>{n}×</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs">
            ≈ ${est.toFixed(2)} for {picked.size * sets.size * repeat} runs · ${left.toFixed(2)} of ${budget} left
          </span>
          <Button variant="outline" disabled={busy || !picked.size || !sets.size || est > left} onClick={go}>{busy ? "Starting…" : "Run suite"}</Button>
        </div>
        {err && <p className="text-sm text-destructive md:col-span-2">{err}</p>}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import ArenaForm from "@/components/ArenaForm";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { listArenas, suiteCells } from "@/lib/arena";
import { evalsets, experiment, frozenWeek, getCompany, loadKey } from "@/lib/config";
import { budgetUsd, spentUsd } from "@/lib/store";

/** Interviewer landing page: the pre-computed eval suite first; launching a new (paid) one is secondary. */
export default async function Home() {
  await connection();
  const [arenas, spent] = await Promise.all([listArenas(), spentUsd()]);
  const latest = arenas.find((a) => !a.running) ?? arenas[0];
  const sets = evalsets().map((e) => ({
    id: e.id,
    label: `${getCompany(e.company).name} · ${e.windowStart.slice(5)}–${e.windowEnd.slice(5)}`,
    split: e.split,
    docs: frozenWeek(e.windowStart, e.windowEnd)?.length ?? 0,
    keyed: loadKey(e.company, e.windowStart, e.windowEnd)?.relevant.length ?? null,
  }));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {latest ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Eval results</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Pre-computed: opens instantly, nothing re-runs.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            <Link href={`/arena/${latest.id}`} className="rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium">
              Open the scoreboard →
            </Link>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {latest.runs} runs · ${latest.costUsd.toFixed(2)} · {new Date(latest.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No eval suite yet.</p>
      )}
      <ArenaForm
        evalsets={sets}
        setups={suiteCells().map((c) => ({ id: c.key, label: c.label, model: c.model, estUsd: c.estUsd }))}
        repeatOptions={experiment().arena.repeatOptions}
        spent={spent}
        budget={budgetUsd()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// Trace checks are pure functions of a finished trace file: cache them per file + mtime so the dashboard
// doesn't gunzip and re-check every trace on each render.
const checkCache = new Map<string, { mtimeMs: number; checks: ReturnType<typeof checkTrace> }>();
function cachedChecks(runId: string) {
  const f = traceFile(runId);
  if (!f) return null;
  const { mtimeMs } = fs.statSync(f);
  const hit = checkCache.get(f);
  if (hit && hit.mtimeMs === mtimeMs) return hit.checks;
  const events = readTrace(runId);
  if (!events.length) return null;
  const checks = checkTrace(events as never);
  checkCache.set(f, { mtimeMs, checks });
  return checks;

**Setup:** 3 everyday companies (food, pharmacy, airline) × 2 frozen weeks (Nov 9–13 = dev, Nov 2–6 = held-out
test) × 5 setups × 3 repeats = 90 runs, $27.65. Keys: two blind drafts (Opus + Sonnet) reconciled by a third blind
agent: 14 should-flag rules, 79 traps. Graded by code vs the key, deterministic trace checks, and a 3-vendor judge
panel (2 of 3).

| Setup | Score | Found | Flags right | Traps avoided | $/run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Jev → Sonnet, strict prompt** | **89%** | 93% | 79.6% | 97% | $0.13 |
| Sonnet reads everything | 85% | 100% | 44% | 79% | $0.62 |
| Jev → Sonnet | 85% | 98% | 45% | 82% | $0.16 |
| Jev → GPT (cheap) | 84% | 86% | 44% | 85% | $0.10 |
| Baseline (Sonnet + web search) | 83% | 71% | 79% | 97% | $0.53 |

- **The prompt matters more than the model.** Spelling out what does NOT count (other models or industries,
  closed periods, paperwork) cut trap hits from 43 to 8 with almost no recall loss. On the held-out week the strict
  setup handled 124/132 cases vs 109/132 with the default prompt. Caveat: that claim is about traps; recall on the

- **Recall rests on 14 distinct rules** (42 checks with repeats); the strict setup's 3 misses are 3 different rules,
  each missed in 1 of 3 runs.
- **Tier gap:** past-dated *notices* (e.g. SNAP candy bans already in force Nov 1) get no headline date and tier Low;
  the "recently effective" rule only covers final rules. Fix in the real build (`pipeline.yaml → tiering`).
- **Full text:** federalregister.gov serves a captcha to scripts; govinfo.gov has the same GPO text. Before the fix,
  15/22 "full texts" were block pages (dates still came out right via structured API fields).
- **Judges:** Opus was the lenient judge (it passed nearly everything); the 2-of-3 vote absorbs that.
- **Config pinning:** a suite must freeze config at start. An edit mid-suite crashed one attempt (`pinConfig()` now).
- **Possible key bias:** keys were drafted by Claude models; the only non-Claude setup ranks lowest on recall.

## For the real build

- Load `config/` and the export bundle (`scripts/export.mts`) as-is; formats are in `SCHEMA.md`.
- Serve eval results as static files (`public/evals/<suite>/`, traces `.jsonl.gz`); stream + window the trace

- Scale: add a free rules-based prefilter (agency, CFR part, doc type) before Jev, prompt-cache the profile, and cache
  verdicts per (profile, doc).
'''

  • Winner: the strict prompt. Spelling out what doesn't count cut trap hits from 43 to 8 with almost no loss in what it finds. It also held up on the held-out week (124 of 132 cases right, against 109 with the normal prompt). That holds for traps; for recall the test week has too few rules to say much.
  • Baseline: it flags little, so it's precise, but it missed 4 of the 9 rules that directly affect the company. It's also the only setup failing trace checks, because it shows unverified dates and writes dates into its action text.

  • A gap to fix in the real build: notices that are already in force, like the SNAP candy bans from Nov 1, get no headline date and come out Low.
  • Possible key bias: the answer keys were drafted by Claude models, and the only non-Claude setup ranks lowest on recall.

Data: - data/evals/<suite>/ and data/user-view/ hold only the current runs, each with its gzipped trace. - The 196 older runs are deleted, and their $32 is kept in data/spend-ledger.json so the cap still counts it. - The cache and labels folders are gone. - The leftover pages, scripts and old scoring code are deleted too. - File formats are in poc/SCHEMA.md, and the findings plus notes for the real build are in poc/README.md.

Nothing is committed since the config refactor: 131 changed files, including about 38 MB of run data. Want me to commit it on poc?
